items.title: Emeka Egbuka: Working on side Thursday
items.text:
Egbuka (concussion/foot) was working on the side with a trainer at Thursday's practice, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

items.title: Jeremiyah Love: Probably sitting again Week 7
items.text:
The Cardinals expect to remain without Love (ankle) for Sunday's game against the Broncos, Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports Thursday.

items.title: Saquon Barkley: On track for MNF
items.text:
